purpose: Approved reusable reference templates for teammates building new courses with CanvasDaemon.

image_style_reference.description: High-school illustrated course style: student-facing, classroom/story setting, concrete learning metaphor, warm visual tone.

templates.title: Intro to Applied AI
templates.reason: Sets the promise, scope, learner expectations, and first action in a compact landing page.
templates.adaptation: Replace course promises, counts, welcome videos, and hero artwork.

dependencies.alt: Futuristic timeline showing AI evolving from a 1951 checkers program to modern recommendation, chatbot, image generation, and AI assistant systems

templates.title: Four phases. One complete picture of AI.
templates.reason: Strong visual progression from phase cards to expandable details; useful for any multi-part course.
templates.adaptation: Replace phases, sequencing, illustrations, and phase links.

dependencies.alt: Futuristic four-phase AI course roadmap with glowing path from foundations to code lab, modern AI, and final app launch
Playful robot detective investigating everyday examples to decide what counts as AI
Playful robot debugging Python code while data blocks feed into a machine learning model
Futuristic prompt machine turning one prompt into chat, image, code, and tool outputs
AI web app launching like a rocket from a laptop with testing and portfolio panels around it

templates.title: Start with the essentials. Return when you need help.
templates.reason: Clear start-here path with separate portfolio and help resources; avoids an overloaded welcome page.
templates.adaptation: Replace guide destinations and the three supporting illustrations.

dependencies.alt: Students and a friendly robot moving through watching, practice, checking, discussion, and portfolio stations
Students and a friendly robot arranging work from an early idea through a finished AI application
Students asking a friendly robot guide about coding, time, and course tools

templates.title: The Three Forms of Intelligence
templates.reason: Shows the established illustration-and-meme style with a short explanation, video, comparison, and practice.
templates.adaptation: Replace concept content, illustration, reaction GIF, video, and interactive activity.

dependencies.alt: Different types of intelligence shown as three school problem-solving stations with a mildly judgmental checklist.
Relatable reaction GIF illustrating Intelligence can come from a person, a pattern-learning machine, or a group combining knowledge and coordination.

templates.title: Google Colab, Drive, Gemini, and Recovery
templates.reason: Practical setup, reliable work habits, recovery steps, and clear tool-use expectations in one reusable guide.
templates.adaptation: Replace tools, access requirements, setup steps, and recovery instructions.

templates.title: Should This Be an Agent?
templates.reason: The newer discussion design uses a memorable scenario, focused question, response scaffold, and peer-reply expectations.
templates.adaptation: Replace the scenario, reaction GIF, prompt, reply rules, and attribution.

dependencies.alt: Kermit typing furiously, illustrating an agent rushing to send a message before review.

templates.title: Review the answers after demonstrating mastery.
templates.reason: Consistent question cards explain the correct answers and reasons, making the review format easy to reuse.
templates.adaptation: Replace all questions/answers and configure real access restrictions in Canvas. Page text alone does not enforce the mastery gate.

templates.title: How AI Learns from Data
templates.reason: Your requested Module 2 overview: a motivating question, outcomes, module journey, and completion expectations.
templates.adaptation: Replace module metadata, outcomes, visual, completion rules, and links.

dependencies.alt: High-school students sorting everyday examples into patterns for machine learning practice

templates.title: Data Is the Starting Point
templates.reason: Module 2 Lesson 1, “Data Is the Starting Point”: a clear video → concept blocks → synthesis sequence with the existing course artwork.
templates.adaptation: Replace the big question, video, concept blocks, and synthesis prompts.

templates.title: Quick, Draw! Pattern Detective
templates.reason: The actual Quick, Draw! Pattern Detective mini activity embedded inside a Module 2 micro-learning concept page. Includes observation fields, progress, and feedback.
templates.adaptation: Replace case evidence, review steps, output, and success criteria.

templates.title: Autonomy Needs Boundaries.
templates.reason: The current Module 14 summary, including its wrap-up video, connecting story, and takeaways.
templates.adaptation: Replace the story, key ideas, map, and next-step link.

templates.title: Module 14 Progress Checklist
templates.reason: The Module 14 (Phase 3) checklist with its actual interactive tracker, browser-saved checkmarks, progress count, and reset control.
templates.adaptation: Regenerate every item and link from the new course; do not retain old completion claims.
